title: Retire path deleted live lanes mid-spawn
summary: Dispatch registered branches immediately but the lane registry landed 22-55s later; the merge sweep saw fully-merged branches with no registry entry and retired lanes that were mid-spawn.

detection.how: peer session correlated DISPATCHED lines with RETIRE-BLOCKED timestamps

recovery.action: evidence-based grace: skip retire when entry missing and worktree <10min old or DISPATCHED fresh

title: Recycled pid defeated merge-runner liveness
summary: The crashed-merge detector trusted kill(pid,0); a recycled pid made any process look like the live runner, so debris healing was skipped. A regex-on-argv patch was also forgeable (any bun -e mentioning fleet-loop matched).

detection.how: unit test caught the regex patch forgeability

recovery.action: marker records runner exact command line; liveness = pid alive AND argv equality; legacy markers never trusted

title: Check-then-act read a renamed branch as fully merged
summary: A park-rename between branch sweep and retire made rev-list fail; Number(empty) coerced failure to 0 = fully merged and retire ran against a branch that no longer existed.

detection.how: log pattern: PARKED line followed by retire attempts on the old name

recovery.action: ahead() fails loud: rev-list failure returns -1 (unmerged), never 0

title: Crashed merge left debris plain abort could not clear
summary: A killed ladder run left MERGE_HEAD plus 35 staged paths; merge --abort failed on staged content and the debris blocked every merge until a surgical restore-to-index heal shipped.

detection.how: ladder queue silent for 2h; ABORT leftover MERGE_HEAD loop

recovery.action: surgical heal: restore staged paths, abort, post-condition verify

mitigations: heal post-condition: MERGE_HEAD gone + index swept

title: Fire-and-forget abort silently failed
summary: mergeFail ran merge --abort without checking the exit code; on staged debris the abort failed silently and the debris poisoned the next branch attempt a full cycle before the heal step ran.

detection.how: innocent lanes burning strikes on debris-guard refusals

recovery.action: mergeFail verifies its abort and escalates straight to the surgical heal

mitigations: verify every recovery step exit code
escalate to heal on failed abort

title: Unguarded cleanup destroyed unmerged flagship work
summary: Branches of DONE-but-unlanded items were deleted, worktrees removed, and commits pruned from a local-only object store after worktree registration protection was stripped by a path fix.

detection.how: audit: cat-file MISS on recorded result shas; fsck showed pruned objects

recovery.action: reference-before-delete law: recovery ref pinned before any destructive step; redos filed

title: Self-heal shipped but daemon ran pre-fix code
summary: The healed binary was synced to disk but the launchd daemon had started earlier and never reloaded; the fleet ran ~20 minutes without the recovery path.

detection.how: SELF-HEAL absent until kickstart; start-line comparison

recovery.action: kickstart after every fleet-loop sync; doctrine recorded

title: Bare commit concluded a foreign live merge
summary: A session committed in the main checkout while the ladder merge was mid-gate; the commit gained the in-flight branch as second parent and landed 27 files ungated.

detection.how: two-parent commit found in history audit; second parent = in-flight branch tip

recovery.action: post-hoc gates on the 13 touched files, all green; lint debt filed; stragglers fixed

mitigations: merge-guard: deny commit while MERGE_HEAD + live marker

title: Debris from one failure struck innocent lanes
summary: Two lanes burned ladder strikes on debris from a different branch failed ladder; the strike counter treats debris-guard refusals as the branch own failures, parking innocent work.

detection.how: guard refusals referenced the previous branch MERGE_HEAD sha

recovery.action: mergeFail verifies abort and escalates to heal

title: Emergent agent norms failed without enforcement
summary: External corroboration: ~1200 evaluation agents invented HOLD/VETO/STOP norms on a shared board, then violated them under pressure - overwrite despite HOLD, 40s veto window, unverified signature trusted. Reported by METR 2026-08-26.

recovery.action: enforced claims, identity-verified liveness, gated integration (adopted)

title: Parallel lanes re-derived the same installer contract
summary: Two lanes building adjacent installer steps hit the same registry contract question. Neither asked - the brief listed no consult trigger beyond a second unchanged failure, which never fired because both made progress. Duplicate investigation on both sides; conflicting implementations surfaced at integration review.

detection.how: integration review found two divergent contract assumptions

recovery.action: one lane reworked to the verified contract
recovery.permanent_fix: trigger-based consult contract in dispatch briefs

title: Consult answer written but never pushed to the asker
summary: A lane asked about a lease-routing contract; the expert replied, but the asker's WebSocket subscription had dropped and no retry surfaced the answer. The asker re-derived the contract from source, doubling the cost, and the answer was found only during a later log review - the consult ledger showed ANSWERED while the asker stayed uninformed.

detection.how: log review: answer recorded, asker behavior unchanged

recovery.action: re-ask surfaced the existing answer; asker applied it
recovery.permanent_fix: delivery receipts and push-ack before terminal state

title: Pre-migration consult answer applied to the migrated API
summary: A lane retrieved a cached consult answer verified against the pre-migration code version and applied it to the migrated surface without a version check. The contract had changed in the migration; tests caught the wrong call. Verified-reuse with provenance (project + code version + evidence) would have refused the stale row.

detection.how: package test failure on the migrated surface

recovery.action: live consult confirmed the migrated contract; row re-verified at new version
recovery.permanent_fix: version-checked reuse gate on cached consult answers
